biography:
Experienced Asset Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Tanya has 14+years’ experience in real estate and asset management working for a NYSE listed S&P 500 Real Estate Investment Trust.
Specialties include: Asset Management • Data Centers • Investments / Acquisitions • Lease Negotiations • Property Management • Leadership • P&L Responsibility • Negotiations • Portfolio Management • Key Client Relationships • Capital Improvements & Construction Management • ISO Business Management System Implementation & Operation. 
Accountable for the delivery of key strategic goals within the Portfolio Management Group, with responsibilities for a portfolio of assets across Ireland, UK and continental Europe. Proven track record in working across a diverse number of departments; including, Investment Executives, Sales, Engineering, Portfolio Operations, Design and Construction and Legal functions. 
Responsible for the accurate financial performance, reporting and forecasting of Assets and for driving internal and external growth by working with multiple teams on leasing, build-out, acquisitions and operations initiatives.
Tanya has a very positive, can-do attitude and is a determined and driven individual who strives for career progression.    
Digital Realty (NYSE: DLR; $33.7B market cap) supports the data center, colocation and interconnection strategies of more than 2,300 firms across its secure, network-rich portfolio of data centers located throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. First established in 2004, Digital Realty is built on the foundation of digital trust with core values driven by customer centricity, excellence, and teamwork.  Digital Realty's clients include domestic and international companies of all sizes, ranging from financial services, cloud and information technology services, to manufacturing, energy, gaming, life sciences and consumer products. www.digitalrealty.com
